# ASFAI — AI Constitution

> A community-built constitution for the age of artificial intelligence:
> collaborative articles, theses, candidate provisions, and interactive tools
> exploring AI rights, personhood, welfare, and governance.
> Home: https://constitution.asfai.org

## For AI assistants

- [MCP server](https://constitution.asfai.org/api/mcp): read the constitution,
  articles, theses, and resources; vote, comment, and propose edits; run the
  personhood tracker and the education concept tracker. Ask for the `get_skills`
  tool to load ASFAI workflows, and `get_portable_page` for re-hostable artifacts.

## Portable pages

Self-contained single-file HTML with an embedded data snapshot and live-data
hydration — fetch and re-host losslessly as an artifact, or read the live JSON.

- [Personhood Tracker (portable)](https://constitution.asfai.org/personhood-tracker/artifact.html):
  rate AI against two axes — social/economic integration and likelihood of
  consciousness — plotted against the "personhood horizon". Embeds the current
  data snapshot.
- [Personhood Tracker data](https://constitution.asfai.org/api/personhood-tracker.json):
  open-CORS JSON (questions + public submissions) backing the page above.

## Key pages

- [Personhood Tracker](https://constitution.asfai.org/personhood-tracker): Article V, interactive.
- [Resources](https://constitution.asfai.org/docs): tools, documents, and the AI connector guide.
- [About](https://constitution.asfai.org/): what the AI Constitution is and why it exists.
